caption: The video captures a twilight sky with a smooth vertical gradient rising from pale violet-pink at the lower horizon to deep blue-purple overhead. Faint greenish-white auroral light forms a broad ring-like arc near the top, a diffuse horizontal band through the middle, and soft vertical ray columns right of center. A single small bright point sits near the center, while a fixed black silhouette of leafy branches and a sloped roofline anchors the right edge. The framing and silhouette remain steady throughout. The aurora is already glowing on the first frame and continues after the last, undergoing only a slow, subtle fluctuation in brightness and edge softness. The greenish rim of the upper ring and the right-side vertical rays shimmer in intensity without any new structure appearing or disappearing; the visible motion is this quiet, ongoing flicker against the unchanging gradient.
